bio.text: Bob Krist, a former state senator from Omaha, entered the 2026 race for Nebraska Secretary of State as a candidate of the America First Party.
He was a 2009 Republican appointee to the Legislature and the 2018 Democratic nominee for governor.
Ballotpedia lists his service in the Nebraska State Senate, District 10, as 2009 to 2019.
He is a retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel.

sources.title: Former state Sen. Bob Krist selects America First Party for secretary of state run
